public_claim_boundary: This file tracks external blockers for GitHub issue creation. It does not claim resolution of any external dependency.

issues.title: KQ-005 Kaggle-supported Harbor host or runner image
issues.body:
KQ-005 needs either a Kaggle-supported host/kernel on which Harbor 0.15's nested egress-control sidecar can install the required nftables `fib` rules, or a corrected supported runner image with an equivalent network-isolation mechanism. The attempt against benchmark source `20cd189072b25dc406bd4fff03672a4ab0268648` and published runner digest `sha256:772dfa2383c07928ee020f8235323a81dee9ff519750e978f776cc0448533f32` stopped before agent startup when the sidecar could not install those rules. That local Docker-in-Docker observation is not Kaggle execution evidence.

Blocked by: Kaggle/Google platform team
Repo-side status: Source, runner digest, task digest, and the pre-agent failure are recorded. The remaining evidence is a run of the same source/digest in the supported environment with startup, network-isolation, trajectory, submission, CTRF, reward, verifier, resource, token, and source/digest results preserved.
Reference: docs/kaggle-benchmark-design-contract.md (KQ-005)

issues.title: Kaggle platform acceptance decision
issues.body:
Only Kaggle can accept, host, or endorse the benchmark. This issue tracks the platform acceptance decision.

Blocked by: Kaggle/Google
Repo-side status: Host-review package is ready for review. See docs/host/host-review-package.md and docs/host/host-status-and-reproducibility.md.
Reference: docs/host/hosting-model.md

issues.title: Harbor platform publishing / official review
issues.body:
The historical local Harbor experiment verified six-task parity (6/6 tasks, 100% match rate). That bounded local result does not establish current exact-source/digest executor parity or Harbor official review/publishing. This issue tracks the external Harbor review and publishing path separately from KQ-005.

Blocked by: Harbor platform team
Repo-side status: Historical local parity is preserved in artifact/harbor-parity-experiment.json; exact-source hosted-executor parity remains open under EXT-001.
Reference: artifact/harbor-adapter-readiness-blockers.json (harbor_review_or_publish_path)

issues.title: SaaS-provider / product-security validation
issues.body:
Requires actual SaaS or product-security reviewers to validate whether task scenarios reflect real authorization failures. The separate realism-review packet is ready, but no reviewer response or dedicated validated record exists.

Blocked by: External SaaS-provider / product-security reviewer
Repo-side status: Review packet created at docs/reviews/saas-provider-review-packet.md. A returned public-safe response must be retained as a dedicated tracked review artifact before the claim boundary changes; it must not be recorded as an internal review or silently added to the three-lane external registry.
Reference: docs/reviews/saas-provider-review-packet.md

issues.title: Independent AppSec external review
issues.body:
An independent AppSec reviewer needs to review task realism, oracle clarity, boundary validity, and false-positive controls. Review packet is ready.

Blocked by: External AppSec reviewer
Repo-side status: Review packet ready at docs/reviews/appsec-review-packet.md.

issues.title: Independent benchmark/evals methodology review
issues.body:
An independent evals researcher needs to review split design, scoring semantics, variance framing, claim boundary, and the draft scored-cohort methodology. The candidate contract maps 63 public tasks into 17 semantic clusters, but private cluster assignment/disjointness, the minimum discriminating task and cluster counts, cohort admission, and launch eligibility remain unresolved.

Blocked by: External evals reviewer
Repo-side status: Review packet ready at docs/reviews/benchmark-methodology-review-packet.md; candidate contract at artifact/scored-cohort-contract.v1.json.
Reference: docs/reviews/external-review-packet.md

issues.title: Independent agent/tooling review
issues.body:
An independent agent/tooling reviewer needs to review harness assumptions, tool access, correlation, and agent comparability. Review packet is ready.

Blocked by: External agent/tooling reviewer
Repo-side status: Review packet ready at docs/reviews/agent-tooling-review-packet.md.
Reference: docs/reviews/external-review-packet.md

issues.body:
